meta.name: dashboard
meta.description: Review the portfolio across existing engagement records. Use for status across customers; requires accessible permitted records and does not create missing client histories.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把每位客户的服务进展汇成一张总览,随时看清当前状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果同时服务多位客户,需要随时掌握各自的进展
copy.tagline_en: See every client's engagement status pulled together in one overview
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you serve several clients and need a quick read on each one's status

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会读取已有的合作（engagement）记录，汇总并报告各客户的状态。遇到记录缺失或没有访问权限时，它会把这一点作为限制如实说明，不会为了完成任务去新建客户历史。
howto.when: 当你要求查看跨客户的状态，或由 @fde 调用时，它会在其既有范围内接管；前提是存在可访问、已获许可的记录。

say.text: 汇总一下现有合作记录里的客户状态
say.note: 基于已有记录出状态汇总，不新建记录

say.text: 这些客户里哪些记录缺失或没权限访问？
say.note: 缺失与权限问题会作为限制列出

say.text: @fde 已经给了脱敏 packet，按它的范围做状态汇总
say.note: 直接复用 @fde 的 packet 与范围，不重跑准备

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reviews your existing engagement records and reports status across customers. It only works from accessible, permitted records, and reports missing records or access as a limitation instead of creating client histories.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for status across customers, or when called by @fde, which reuses its current sanitized packet and scope. Requires accessible, permitted records.

say_en.text: Summarize the status across customers from the existing engagement records.
say_en.note: Reports status from existing records; creates none.

say_en.text: Which customers have missing records or no access?
say_en.note: Gaps and access issues are listed as limitations.

say_en.text: @fde already passed its sanitized packet — summarize status in that scope.
say_en.note: Reuses @fde's packet and scope; no restart.
